title: Every Space console back link returns to its real parent tab, and the sidebar is grouped with Spotlight beside the page editor

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20 in the project chat: walk every Space link trail so a back link returns to the previous page, make the nav layers clearer, and move the Spotlight controls somewhere prominent in the Space admin menu.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. PREMISE RE-TESTED. FOUND: Loom Studio, Journeys, Practices, Circles, Airwaves, Program and Leadership all said Back to manage or Manage and returned to Home, not the Content & Programs tab they are cards on; the CRM sub pages said CRM; about fifteen settings pages (Members, Get paid, Offerings, Shop, Email, QR, Reach and the rest) had no back link at all; Spotlight, Layout and Mode lit Home in the sidebar and had no back link; Spotlight was only reachable from a card inside the page panel. FIX: lib/spaces/console-back.ts is the one place a back link is built, from the hub tab the catalog row declares, so the link and the highlighted sidebar row agree. The sidebar is four labelled groups (Your public pages, Run, Money and reach, Your Space) with Spotlight beside the page editor; Layout, Mode and Menu and features light Profile & Settings. Menu and features back link left for the tier chip PR (#3746), which edits that page.

verify.note: Fails when a console page goes back to saying Back to manage, loses its parent back link, or Spotlight leaves the sidebar.
